g.text: Besu: layered eviction during a single attack broadcast

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #58636c

g.text: G1 drain, seed01. All 7,040 drops precede the first attack receipt in the next block; G2 also has 7,040 confirmed drops.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #58636c

g.text: Layer movement is not final eviction; the observer has at most one tx between layer events at any instant.
